message.abstract: This Book (White Paper v. 3, v.4 - see https://osf.io/8uch5) proposes a Project Conception of Artificial Super Intelligence ASI, based on (strong) system approach and wide theoretical-methodological framework – Cybernetics, Synergetics, Semiotics, Mathematics, Cognitology and Artificial Intelligence. Contents:•IDEOLOGY and STRATEGY of the ASI Project•THEORY and METHODOLOGY of ASI Development•CONCEPTUAL MODEL of ASI System•PRE-PROJECT R and D Task Setting•CONCLUSION and DISCUSSION, incl. AI Safety•APPENDICES with reviews of relevant scientific and R and D areas, incl. frontier AI ModelsThe Book may be useful and interesting for the staff of organizations and enterprises concerned with AI R and D and implementations in different areas, firstly – perspective AGI/ASI systems. In addition – for Customers, Investors and Sponsors of such R and Ds, private, public and states – its owners and officials. Of course - all intellectual, educated and ethical people with progressive worldviews, interested or anyway considered in above presented problematics.This version 3 (15), Version 4 (16) - 2024 UPDATE published as Project - see here: https://osf.io/8uch5
title: SKYNET 2023 Conception of the Artificial Super Intelligence Project. A System Approach. ver. 3
